Google documents self plus other-version annotations as a complete configuration requirement, so disappearance of this measured anomaly alone does not establish that full configuration. Reference: https://developers.google.com/search/docs/specialty/international/localized-versions .

Only the proved two-language same-host literal static subset is measured.
